item.description:

Solutions based on large language models (LLMs) often rely on temperature sampling to improve accuracy and stability by aggregating multiple samples from the completion distribution. However, this memoryless approach is inherently suboptimal: because it lacks awareness of prior generations and their evaluations, it produces an increasing proportion of semantically duplicate answers as more...

WHY IT MATTERS

FLEET introduces a clever memory-augmented trajectory approach to replace standard temperature sampling, offering concrete speedups and coding accuracy gains without hype.
